subobjective: Describe Microsoft Entra roles and role-based access control (RBAC)
stem: A cloud operator needs to start and stop virtual machines in a subscription but should not manage users in Microsoft Entra ID. Which access model fits?

choices.text: Global Administrator, because Azure VM power-state is a directory setting
A sensitivity label published to the operator
Microsoft Sentinel hunting queries, which grant VM start rights
Azure resource RBAC for the subscription or resource group, not an Entra directory role

explanation: Azure RBAC authorizes Azure resource actions such as VM operations. Entra roles authorize directory administration. Those planes are not interchangeable.

source.title: Overview of Microsoft Entra role-based access control (RBAC) - Microsoft Entra ID

stem: On an employee's first day, security wants an automated workflow to create the Entra account, add a welcome group, and send a manager task. Which ID Governance capability is designed for that joiner path?

choices.text: Lifecycle workflows that automate joiner, mover, and leaver identity tasks
Azure Firewall DNAT rules that create users when port 443 is allowed
Defender Threat Intelligence actor profiles
Network security groups that provision mailboxes

explanation: Lifecycle workflows automate joiner-mover-leaver identity tasks. Firewall, threat intelligence, and NSGs do not provision Entra joiner processes.

source.title: What are lifecycle workflows? - Microsoft Entra ID Governance

stem: Users should request a bundle of groups, apps, and roles for a project, with approval and a time limit. How does that differ from Privileged Identity Management?

choices.text: Entitlement management is only for Global Administrators, and PIM is only for guest password reset
Entitlement management packages project access for users; PIM activates privileged directory or Azure roles just in time
Both capabilities are Azure WAF policies with different names
PIM publishes sensitivity labels, and entitlement management is a DDoS plan

explanation: Entitlement management issues access packages. PIM governs activation of privileged roles. They are related governance tools with different jobs.

source.title: Microsoft Entra ID Governance - Microsoft Entra ID Governance

stem: Group owners must periodically confirm that guests still need a project group. Why is that not the same as Privileged Identity Management?

choices.text: Access reviews recertify whether existing access should continue; PIM activates privileged roles just in time
Access reviews are the only way to require MFA on role activation
PIM recertifies guest groups, and access reviews encrypt virtual machines
They are identical services with two marketing names

explanation: Access reviews ask whether current access is still justified. PIM is about time-bound privileged-role activation, not guest-group recertification.

source.title: What are access reviews? - Microsoft Entra - Microsoft Entra ID Governance

stem: A user's risk is high because leaked credentials were found. Security wants that user blocked or forced to a secure password reset before further access. Which pairing is appropriate?

choices.text: Azure Bastion session recording as the leaked-credential control
ID Protection risk combined with Conditional Access user-risk policy
Records management file-plan disposition
Defender for Office 365 Safe Attachments as the only leaked-credential control

explanation: ID Protection calculates identity risk and Conditional Access can require remediation such as password reset or block. Bastion, records, and Safe Attachments are not leaked-credential identity-risk engines.

source.title: What is Microsoft Entra ID Protection? - Microsoft Entra ID Protection

stem: A company already uses AD FS and wants cloud apps to trust those on-premises federation claims. Which hybrid identity option is that?

choices.text: Password hash synchronization only, which never uses federation
Federation with an on-premises identity provider such as AD FS
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps session policy as the directory sync engine
Compliance Manager improvement actions that issue SAML tokens

explanation: Hybrid identity can federate authentication to AD FS or another IdP. PHS is a different cloud-auth path, and Defender for Cloud Apps or Compliance Manager are not federation engines.

source.title: What is hybrid identity with Microsoft Entra ID? - Microsoft Entra ID

subobjective: Describe password protection and management capabilities
stem: Hybrid users reset passwords in the cloud and must have the new password written back to on-premises Active Directory. Which password-management capability is required?

choices.text: Azure Key Vault access policies that rewrite AD DS passwords
Self-service password reset with password writeback
eDiscovery holds that push password hashes to domain controllers
Azure WAF custom rules that perform directory writeback

explanation: SSPR with password writeback updates on-premises AD after a cloud reset. Key Vault, eDiscovery, and WAF do not write hybrid passwords back to AD DS.

source.title: Self-service password reset deep dive - Microsoft Entra ID

stem: Security wants phishing-resistant sign-in for admins and is willing to retire SMS one-time codes for those accounts. Which comparison is accurate at SC-900 level?

choices.text: SMS one-time codes are more phishing-resistant than FIDO2 keys
SMS codes are retention labels, and FIDO2 keys are NSG rules
FIDO2 security keys are phishing-resistant possession methods; SMS codes are easier to intercept or phish
Phishing resistance is measured only by compliance score

explanation: Microsoft treats FIDO2/passkeys as phishing-resistant. SMS can still be phished or intercepted, so it is a weaker authentication method for high-value accounts.

source.title: Microsoft Entra authentication overview - Microsoft Entra ID

stem: A compliance analyst says Conditional Access can classify a Word document as confidential and prevent it from being emailed. What is the accurate correction?

choices.text: Conditional Access evaluates sign-in conditions and grant or session controls; classification and email DLP are Purview capabilities
Conditional Access is the only Microsoft service that applies sensitivity labels
Conditional Access declares records and therefore blocks all email
Conditional Access is a Defender for Office 365 Safe Links wrapper

explanation: Conditional Access is an identity policy engine. Labeling and DLP protect content. Using CA as a substitute for Purview information protection is a category error.

source.title: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access: Zero Trust Policy Engine - Microsoft Entra ID

stem: Developers currently store usernames and passwords inside each line-of-business app. Security wants one cloud directory those apps can trust instead. Which service is the SC-900 answer?

choices.text: Azure DDoS Protection as the application identity store
Microsoft Purview Activity explorer as the token issuer
Azure Bastion as the organizational identity provider
Microsoft Entra ID as the cloud identity and access management directory

explanation: Entra ID is the cloud IAM directory apps can trust. DDoS Protection, Activity explorer, and Bastion are not identity directories.

source.title: What is Microsoft Entra? - Microsoft Entra

subobjective: Describe types of identities, including agent ID
stem: A background integration uses a registered application identity with no human signing in. How does that identity type differ from a user account?

choices.text: Workload identities are guest users who must complete MFA every hour
Workload or application identities represent apps or services, not a person who interactively signs in
Application identities are sensitivity labels attached to service principals
Only user accounts can be granted Azure RBAC roles; apps cannot have identities

explanation: Workload/app identities authenticate services without a human sign-in. They are not guests, labels, or a prohibition on app authorization.

source.title: Architecture overview - Microsoft Entra

subobjective: Describe Microsoft Entra roles and role-based access control (RBAC)
stem: Helpdesk should reset user passwords but must not manage billing or Conditional Access policies. Which Entra practice matches least privilege?

choices.text: Assign Global Administrator and then hide the billing blade in the portal
Assign Azure Firewall Contributor, which includes password reset
Assign a built-in password-administration role instead of Global Administrator
Assign Compliance Manager assessor, which resets Entra passwords

explanation: Entra built-in roles such as password administration target a job without standing Global Administrator. Hiding blades or using firewall/compliance roles does not implement directory least privilege.

source.title: Overview of Microsoft Entra role-based access control (RBAC) - Microsoft Entra ID

stem: A user completes MFA and is then denied access to a finance SharePoint site. A helpdesk agent says MFA failure is the only possible explanation. What is the better reading?

choices.text: MFA encrypts SharePoint libraries, so denial means hashing failed
MFA is a DLP policy that deletes site permissions
MFA recertifies guest groups, which is the only SharePoint authorization model
MFA succeeded as authentication; a separate authorization decision still denied the site

explanation: MFA is an authentication strength control. SharePoint access is still authorized by permissions, groups, or Conditional Access grant outcomes. Completing MFA does not grant every site.

source.title: Microsoft Entra multifactor authentication overview - Microsoft Entra ID

stem: A team used a temporary SharePoint group for a six-week audit. After the audit, owners should be forced to keep or remove remaining members. Which governance control is that recertification?

choices.text: An access review on the group's membership
A Defender for Cloud secure-score recommendation
An Azure Firewall threat-intelligence rule
A Temporary Access Pass issued to the group

explanation: Access reviews recertify group membership after a project ends. Secure score, firewall TI, and TAP do not recertify SharePoint group members.

source.title: What are access reviews? - Microsoft Entra - Microsoft Entra ID Governance

stem: Which Microsoft Entra ID Governance family includes access packages, access reviews, Privileged Identity Management, and lifecycle workflows?

choices.text: Microsoft Defender XDR email workloads
Azure virtual network segmentation
Microsoft Entra ID Governance identity-governance capabilities
Microsoft Purview records management

explanation: ID Governance is the family that groups entitlement management, access reviews, PIM, and lifecycle workflows. XDR, VNets, and records management are different solution areas.

source.title: Microsoft Entra ID Governance - Microsoft Entra ID Governance

subobjective: Describe the capabilities of Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management
stem: An auditor asks whether anyone permanently holds Privileged Role Administrator. Security wants assignments to stay eligible until a person activates them. Which PIM idea is that?

choices.text: Publishing a sensitivity label named Eligible Admin
Placing the directory in eDiscovery hold to remove standing roles
Eligible assignments instead of permanent active privileged assignments
Using Azure Bastion native client as the privileged-role catalog

explanation: PIM eligible assignments avoid standing active privilege until activation. Labels, eDiscovery, and Bastion do not convert directory roles to eligible.

source.title: What is Privileged Identity Management? - Microsoft Entra ID Governance

stem: A payroll app should be reachable from iOS and Android managed devices but blocked from unmanaged Windows PCs. Which Conditional Access condition supports that split?

choices.text: A Key Vault secret named LegacyAuth
A DLP policy that classifies Windows as a sensitive information type
Device platform conditions that include or exclude operating systems
A Defender Vulnerability Management browser update

explanation: Conditional Access can use device platform as a condition. Key Vault, DLP SITs, and vulnerability management do not select OS platforms for app access.

source.title: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access: Zero Trust Policy Engine - Microsoft Entra ID

stem: Your app does not authenticate partner employees directly. It accepts tokens from the partner's identity provider over a configured trust. Which identity concept is in use?

choices.text: Hashing, in which the app decrypts partner passwords
Cloud workload protection, in which tokens are server threat detections
Federation, in which a relying party trusts claims from an external identity provider
Records management, in which tokens are declared records

explanation: Federation lets a relying party trust another organization's IdP. Hashing, CWP, and records management are not token-trust relationships.

source.title: Describe Identity Concepts

stem: A developer says every application must store and validate its own passwords to be secure. Which identity-provider correction is accurate?

choices.text: Identity providers are only for DDoS logs and cannot authenticate people
Storing passwords in each app is required before Conditional Access can work
Apps can trust an identity provider such as Entra ID instead of storing passwords locally
Identity providers replace encryption, so apps should disable TLS

explanation: A central identity provider authenticates users and issues tokens. Local password stores in every app are not a security requirement and increase credential sprawl.

source.title: Describe Identity Concepts

stem: An application needs a TLS certificate and a database connection string at runtime, and developers must not check those values into Git. Which Azure service is designed to store both?

choices.text: Microsoft Entra access reviews
Privileged Identity Management activation alerts
Azure Key Vault, which stores secrets, keys, and certificates
Purview Content explorer

explanation: Key Vault stores secrets, keys, and certificates so apps retrieve them at runtime instead of embedding them in source control. Access reviews, PIM alerts, and Content explorer are not secret stores.

source.title: What is Azure Key Vault?

stem: A hub must filter TCP/UDP flows between virtual networks, while a public website also needs inspection of HTTP cookies and request bodies. Which pairing is accurate?

choices.text: Azure Firewall filters network flows; Azure WAF inspects HTTP application requests
Azure WAF is the only service that can filter virtual-network TCP flows in a hub
Azure Firewall recertifies guest users, and WAF issues MFA challenges
Firewall and WAF are both Microsoft Defender for Identity sensors

explanation: Azure Firewall is a network-layer (and related) traffic filter. WAF inspects HTTP application payloads. They address different layers and are not identity sensors.

source.title: What is Azure Firewall?

stem: A public website stays online during a large volumetric flood, but users can still be phished by a fake sign-in page. What does that illustrate about Azure DDoS Protection?

choices.text: DDoS Protection helps availability against floods; it does not by itself stop identity phishing or application-layer abuse
DDoS Protection replaces Microsoft Entra multifactor authentication
DDoS Protection classifies and encrypts SharePoint files
A surviving public IP means Conditional Access is no longer required

explanation: DDoS Protection is an availability control against volumetric attacks. It is not an identity, labeling, or phishing control.

source.title: Azure DDoS Protection Overview

stem: An NSG allows TCP 443 to a web subnet. Attackers then send SQL injection in HTTPS bodies. Why might that NSG still be insufficient?

choices.text: NSGs decrypt TLS and therefore already block injection
An allow-443 NSG is equivalent to Microsoft Entra ID Protection
NSGs filter ports and addresses; they do not inspect HTTP application payloads the way a WAF does
SQL injection is remediated only by Service Trust Portal reports

explanation: NSGs are network allow/deny filters. Application-layer inspection of HTTP payloads is a WAF job. Opening 443 does not imply payload inspection.

source.title: Azure network security groups overview

subobjective: Describe network segmentation with Azure virtual networks
stem: A payment workload must not share the same private address space as a general development environment. Which Azure construct provides that isolation?

choices.text: A Temporary Access Pass issued to the payment subnet
A compliance score target of 100
Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence articles
Separate virtual networks or subnets that segment the workloads

explanation: Virtual networks and subnets segment Azure resources into isolated private address spaces. TAP, compliance score, and Defender TI do not create network isolation.

source.title: What is Azure Virtual Network?

stem: Administrators need browser-based RDP to Azure VMs. Why is Azure Bastion a different answer from a site-to-site VPN?

choices.text: A VPN is the Microsoft service that opens RDP on every public IP
Bastion is an identity provider, and a VPN is a sensitivity label
Bastion and VPN are both names for Microsoft Entra Conditional Access
Bastion provides managed RDP/SSH over TLS to VMs without exposing RDP/SSH ports; a VPN extends network connectivity rather than replacing that managed jump host

explanation: Bastion is a managed jump-host service for RDP/SSH over TLS. A VPN connects networks; it is not the SC-900 control that removes public RDP/SSH from VMs.
